_comment: The Grade 2 Art & Design standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Eight lessons against Cambridge Primary Art & Design 0067 Stage 2 - the same ten objectives as Stage 1 and the same Stages 1-2 progression text, so Grade 2 steps up by CONTENT (see README.md :: The Stage 1 / Stage 2 line): printing, weaving, clay sculpture, nature, collage by colour, cameras and movement, and connecting a child's own work with an artist's. hubStrands: Printing with leaves, sponges and stamps; weaving over and under; walking outside and collecting things from nature; looking closely at printed cloth, a loom, a clay head from long ago and a paper cut; and recording what we find by drawing, sorting and moving.

Printing patterns that repeat; mixing tints and shades; weaving with wool, ribbon and paper; joining clay so it stays joined; tearing, cutting and sticking a collage; and choosing the right material, colour or tool for the job, a camera included.
Grouping pictures by the feeling they give; saying what is the same in our work and an artist's; celebrating our friends' work with kind and true words; and looking back through a year of making.
Having an idea and adding the thing that shows it; asking why two things would not join, and fixing it; trying new tools; and getting our work ready to show, together.
